messages:
Tara Nguyen: quick kickoff for Mosaic Analytics onboarding. Short thread to align stakeholders, acceptance gates, and a tight 10-day pilot plan. Mosaic requests Private deployment (VPC), KMS integration, restricted logs (30d), and an SOC2 evidence bundle. Pilot flag date planned for 2026-07-22. Success targets: 95th pct latency < 180ms for expected pilot bursts, uptime >= 99.95%, and eval pass rate >= 93% on 800-sample set. Who picks up infra vs enablement?

Liam O'Connor: I can own infra + smoke tests. Recommend q4 quantized model for throughput; validated on A10G. I'll prepare batching + KV cache config and a tiny harness. Need staging service account and allowlist IPs to validate routing.

Elliot Ramos: I'll run enablement and the prompt tuning workshop. Propose three sessions: 7/8 14:00 PDT (infra handoff), 7/10 11:00 PDT (prompts), 7/13 10:00 PDT (monitoring & runbook). Can we narrow to afternoons?

Nina Shah: Mosaic prefers afternoons PDT 7/7-7/12. Two asks: a pre-signed SOC2 export and the ability to limit logs retention to 30d during pilot. Also want a canary plan before enabling the feature flag.

Tara Nguyen: we can do 30d retention and provide SOC2 export. Canary required: yes. Proposal: start at 5% traffic, validate for 2 hours, then 25% for 4 hours, then full enable if gates pass.

Liam O'Connor: sample smoke test I'll run after creds:
```
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-llama-q4","input":"health-check"}'
```
I'll include a harness asserting 95thpct latency and a rollback trigger. PR by EOD 7/1.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated: infra handoff scheduled; SOC2 export queued at /onboarding/mosaic/documents.

Nina Shah: clarifying the acceptance gate: can short microbursts exceed 180ms if the 95th remains below target across a 1-hour window? We need a precise gate for feature flag enablement.

Tara Nguyen: good call. Proposed acceptance gate for enabling flag = 95th pct <= 180ms AND error rate <= 2% during a continuous 1-hour validation window at pilot load. If either fails, we abort enablement and fallback to hosted model. Canary steps must include automated rollback on breach.

Liam O'Connor: confirmed. I'll add dashboard panels for 50/95/99 pct latencies and error rate, plus automated rollback at the canary controller. Also will add a health-check endpoint to trigger canary aborts.

Elliot Ramos: action items captured: 1) Liam: infra config PR + harness + rollback + dashboards (due 7/1). 2) Tara: SOC2 export & docs (due 7/2). 3) Elliot: invites + agendas (sent). 4) Nina (Mosaic): staging creds & allowlist IPs (ASAP). Reconvene after infra handoff to validate the smoke test.

Nina Shah: creds and allowlist uploaded to our secure vault and pinged your team. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Tara Nguyen: thanks team  will circulate a short recap after the infra handoff and tag owners @Liam @Elliot @Nina. :white_check_mark:
